title: Notification settings
subtitle: Per alert type: channels, audience, and timing used by scheduled jobs.
missing_category_hint: This category is not in the database yet. Refresh the page or trigger default settings creation via the API.
missing_rule_hint: This setting row is missing. Refresh the page.

sections.categories_hint: Each block groups channels (in-app, email), audience, and related timing. Emails require a user address. Disabling a timing row falls back to server defaults.

fields.channels_hint: Turn on at least one channel to receive this alert type.
fields.channel_in_app_hint: Shows in the in-app notification center.
fields.channel_email_hint: Sent to the account email address when available.
fields.scope_hint: Server-side audience filter for this category.
fields.rule_apply_hint: When off, the server default applies.

categoryDescriptions.CONTRACT_EXPIRY: Exclusivity end dates and contract-related reminders.
categoryDescriptions.AGENT_ACTIVITY: e.g. empty calendar over a period.

contract_expiry_offsets_days.title: Reminders before exclusivity ends
contract_expiry_offsets_days.desc: Days before expiry for each alert (multiple values).

meeting_today_reminder_minutes.title: Same-day meeting reminder margin
meeting_today_reminder_minutes.desc: Shown in the message text (minutes before slot).

empty_calendar_working_days_threshold.title: Empty calendar threshold
empty_calendar_working_days_threshold.desc: Days ahead with no events before alerting.

social_post_no_interaction_days.title: Days without property activity
social_post_no_interaction_days.desc: If no recent event on the property for X days.

visit_followup_after_minutes.title: Visit follow-up (event)
visit_followup_after_minutes.desc: Minutes after a “visit” event ends before admin alert.

edl_after_signature_hours.title: Inventory (EDL) reminder
edl_after_signature_hours.desc: Hours after signature to remind about EDL.

exclusive_reminder_every_days.title: Exclusivity periodic reminder
exclusive_reminder_every_days.desc: One reminder every X days from exclusivity start.

price_revision_after_days.title: Price revision
price_revision_after_days.desc: Days without a price update before alerting.

demand_followup_offsets_hours.title: Demand follow-up (hours)
demand_followup_offsets_hours.desc: Multiple delays in hours since last update.

offer_followup_after_hours.title: Offer follow-up
offer_followup_after_hours.desc: Hours without processing since last offer update.

sales_visit_status_reminder_every_hours.title: Visit status reminder (Visit model)
sales_visit_status_reminder_every_hours.desc: Hours without status update for non-final visits.
